compose.title: Wealth & Health of Nations — animated
compose.description: Each bubble's cx, cy, and r animate via raw-SVG <animate> tags through 2018→2023. The discrete year badge in the corner steps with the data. Hand-laid because Glyph's race-animation encoder emits identical values across frames.

textMark.text: x = GDP/capita · y = life expectancy · bubble area = population · color = continent
